description: This file defines the Calendar class and related classes and functions for managing calendar views, layout, and activities in a CRM system, specifically for the vtiger CRM platform.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Main class for managing calendar views, layout, and activities in the CRM system.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents a calendar layout element such as day, hour, or month, with start and end times.

methods.name: Calendar
methods.description: Constructor for Calendar class, initializes view and date_time.

methods.name: getCalendarView
methods.description: Returns label for a given calendar view type.

methods.name: constructLayout
methods.description: Builds the calendar layout based on current view (day, week, month, year).

methods.name: get_datechange_info
methods.description: Calculates the date string for next or previous period based on current view.

methods.name: add_Activities
methods.description: Fetches and adds activities (appointments) to the calendar slices based on user settings.
